title: Vertical Drama Episode Quality Review Input

script.description: The vertical-drama-script-builder skill's output (or the relevant subset: structure.beats, character_emotional_arcs, cliffhanger).

storyboard.description: The vertical-drama-storyboard-shotgrid skill's output (or the relevant subset: shots[]).

dialogue_plan.description: Optional vertical-drama-dialogue-audio-planner output (or the relevant subset: dialogue_lines[]). When omitted, dialogue_naturalness is scored as null.

density_metrics.description: Optional superset (added 2026-07-07, story-density reform): deterministic density facts pre-computed in code from the platform's canonical speech-budget module. When present, request contract_version 2 and echo this object back VERBATIM as the output's top-level density_metrics — never re-estimate these numbers. See skill.md 'Scorecard v2'.

tie_in_config.description: Optional superset (added 2026-07-07): presence of an enabled tie-in config asks this skill to additionally score scorecard.tie_in_naturalness and produce a short tie_in_assessment. When omitted, or enabled is false, tie_in_naturalness is scored as null and tie_in_assessment is omitted.
